queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:nomenclature_nodes` ( `node_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `parent_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `id_path` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `position` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `timestamp` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`node_id`), KEY `parent_id` (`parent_id`), KEY `status` (`status`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:nomenclature_node_descriptions` ( `node_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description` text, `seo_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`node_id`, `lang_code`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:nomenclature_links` ( `link_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `node_id` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`link_id`), UNIQUE KEY `node_product` (`node_id`, `product_id`), KEY `product_id` (`product_id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
